map.如何使用Softmax 概率？: How do I use Softmax Probabilities?
map.Softmax 概率适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Softmax Probabilities best for?
map.将一组 logits 转换为概率分布。: Convert a set of logits into a probability distribution.
map.Softmax 把 logits 变成和为 1 的概率分布，指数放大差距使最大值: Softmax turns logits into a probability distribution summing to 1, with the exponential amplifying gaps to highlight the max. In implementation, subtract max(z) before exponentiating to avoid overflow; the output probability is not the model's confidence - uncalibrated models are often overconfident.
map.softmax(z)_i=exp(z_i)/Σⱼexp(z_j)，将 logit: softmax(z)_i = exp(z_i)/Σⱼexp(z_j), normalizing logits into a probability distribution summing to 1.
map.输出具平移不变性(全体加常数不变)，但对尺度敏感(乘系数放大差异)。: The output is translation-invariant (unchanged by adding a constant) but scale-sensitive (multiplying amplifies differences).
map.多分类输出层标配，配合交叉熵作损失；数值上先减最大值防溢出。: The standard output layer for multi-class, paired with cross-entropy as loss; numerically subtract the max first to prevent overflow.
map.logits=[2,1,0.1]，减最大值 2 得 [0,−1,−1.9]，ex: logits=[2,1,0.1], subtract max 2 to get [0,-1,-1.9], exp=[1,0.368,0.149], Σ=1.517 -> probabilities=[0.659,0.243,0.098], summing to 1.
map.exp 大数会溢出。softmax 具平移不变性，先减最大值不改变结果却把所有指: Large exp overflows. Softmax is translation-invariant, so subtracting the max changes nothing yet pushes all exponents to <=0, avoiding exp overflow and staying numerically stable.
map.softmax 和 sigmoid 在二分类下等价吗？: Are softmax and sigmoid equivalent for binary classification?
map.等价。二分类 softmax 两维概率互为补数，与对单 logit 用 sigm: Yes. Binary softmax gives complementary two-class probabilities, identical to sigmoid on a single logit; multi-class must use softmax normalization.
